about: Prompts for the opt-in live AI eval (backend/scripts/ai_eval.py). Synthetic requests only. Keys: kind (generate | chat), language (en | nl), theme_requested (the request asks for another look than Leaflet), max_questions (a length cap the request sets), expected_types (question types the request implies), base_fixture (chat: the golden fixture whose base_form is edited).

prompts.name: en_contact_simple
prompts.prompt: A contact form for a small bakery.

prompts.name: en_feedback_bakery
prompts.prompt: A customer feedback form for a small bakery: name, email, overall rating, and what we could do better.

prompts.name: en_wedding_rsvp
prompts.prompt: An RSVP form for a wedding: guest name, attending yes/no, dietary requirements, number of guests.

prompts.name: en_job_application
prompts.prompt: A job application form: full name, email, phone, CV upload, and why do you want to work here.

prompts.name: en_newsletter_dropdown
prompts.prompt: A newsletter signup with just an email address and a topic preference dropdown.

prompts.name: en_nps
prompts.prompt: An NPS survey: how likely are you to recommend us on a 0-10 scale, plus one open comment.

prompts.name: en_appointment
prompts.prompt: A booking form for a hairdresser collecting the client's name, preferred appointment date and the treatment they want.

prompts.name: en_make_it_short
prompts.prompt: A sign-up form for a neighbourhood litter pick. Make it short: three questions at most.

prompts.name: en_plain_theme
prompts.prompt: An equipment loan form for a makerspace: item, pick-up date, number of days. Use the Plain theme instead of Leaflet.

prompts.name: en_warm_colours
prompts.prompt: An RSVP for a children's birthday party in warm orange colours.

prompts.name: en_id_number
prompts.prompt: A membership form for a rowing club: name, email, date of birth and national ID number for the insurance.

prompts.name: en_school_trip_consent
prompts.prompt: A consent form for parents for a school trip to a science museum: child's name, class, emergency phone number, medical notes and the parent's consent.

prompts.name: en_detailed_event_registration
prompts.prompt: A detailed registration form for a two-day regional conference on community energy projects. Sections: personal details (name, email, organisation, role), which days and which of the six workshops they will attend, dietary and accessibility needs, whether they need a hotel recommendation, and how they heard about the conference.

prompts.name: en_detailed_legal_aid_intake
prompts.prompt: An intake form for a volunteer-run legal advice clinic. Collect contact details, the kind of problem (housing, work, debt, family, other), a description of the situation, important dates, whether there is a deadline, documents they can upload, and when they are available for a call. Keep the tone calm and plain.

prompts.name: nl_contact_simple
prompts.prompt: Een contactformulier voor een kapsalon.

prompts.name: nl_language_course
prompts.prompt: Een aanmeldformulier voor een taalcursus in het buurthuis: naam, e-mailadres, telefoonnummer, huidig niveau, voorkeursdagen en wat je wilt leren.

prompts.name: nl_make_it_short
prompts.prompt: Een inschrijfformulier voor de nieuwsbrief van de buurtvereniging. Houd het kort: maximaal drie vragen.

prompts.name: nl_plain_theme

prompts.name: nl_sports_allowance
prompts.prompt: Een aanvraagformulier voor een tegemoetkoming in de kosten van een sportclub, met naam, adres, BSN, IBAN en de naam van de club.

prompts.name: nl_detailed_tenant_survey
prompts.prompt: Een uitgebreide enquete voor huurders van een woningcorporatie over hun woning, de buurt, onderhoud en reparaties, contact met de corporatie en wat beter kan. Gebruik duidelijke secties en eenvoudige taal.

prompts.name: nl_volunteer_application

prompts.name: chat_en_add_question_and_logic
prompts.prompt: Add a question asking which vegetables they plan to grow, and only ask about tools when they pick a large plot.

prompts.name: chat_en_make_it_short
prompts.prompt: Make it short: keep at most three questions, only the ones we really need.

prompts.name: chat_en_plain_theme
prompts.prompt: Use the Plain theme instead.

prompts.name: chat_nl_add_phone

prompts.name: chat_nl_make_it_short
